main_line: 此世并无幸福可言。
main_line_en: There is no happiness in this world.
main_character: 岛田新左卫门 / Shinzaemon Shimada

main_line: 不是每个人，都能成为自己理想中的大人。
main_line_en: Not everyone gets to become the adult they imagined.

main_line: 我欣赏它的纯粹。一个幸存者——不被良心、悔恨或道德幻觉所遮蔽。
main_line_en: I admire its purity. A survivor... unclouded by conscience, remorse, or delusions of morality.

film_title_en: Once Upon a Time in America
main_line: 老了以后，你会发现，即使是你最在意的往事，有时也会想不起来。
main_line_en: All I see is a boy, with a curious look…

main_line: 我们大多数人都活在一种悬置的动画状态里。
main_line_en: Most of us live in a state of suspended animation.

main_line: 四月的某几天，兄弟也能被广播分成两边。
main_line_en: In a few days of April, even brothers can be split by a radio broadcast.
main_character: 奥古斯丁／奥诺雷 / Augustin / Honoré

main_line: 当你不能够再拥有，你唯一可以做的，就是令自己不要忘记。
main_line_en: When you can no longer possess something, the only thing you can do is make sure you never forget.

main_line: 这就是我的秘密，队长。我一直都很愤怒。
main_line_en: That's my secret, Captain. I'm always angry.

main_line: 牲口不懂得宽恕，却比人更早学会了承受。
main_line_en: A beast does not know forgiveness, yet learns to bear more sooner than men.
main_character: 巴尔塔扎尔／玛丽 / Balthazar / Marie

main_line: 或许，自由始于悔恨。
main_line_en: Maybe freedom begins with remorse.

main_line: 你眼里满是仇恨，犹大。很好。仇恨能让人活下去——它给人力量。
main_line_en: Your eyes are full of hate, Judah. That's good. Hate keeps a man alive. It gives him strength.

main_line: 丢的只是一枚棋子。
main_line_en: It was only a chess piece that was lost.

main_line: 有时我想，上帝会不会原谅我们对彼此做过的事？然后我环顾四周——才明白上帝早就离开了这地方。
main_line_en: Sometimes I wonder: will God ever forgive us for what we've done to each other? Then I look around and I realize—God left this place a long time ago.

main_line: 我们自己做选择，也自己付代价。
main_line_en: We make our own choices. We pay our own prices.

main_line: 他们也许能夺走我们的生命，但永远夺不走我们的自由！
main_line_en: They may take our lives, but they'll never take our freedom!

main_line: 我多希望我知道怎么戒掉你。
main_line_en: I wish I knew how to quit you.

main_line: 有一种饥饿，再怎么吃也填不满。
main_line_en: There is a hunger that no amount of eating can fill.

main_line: 你必须成为卡里加里！
main_line_en: You must become Caligari!

main_line: 如果我们燃烧，你们也要一起烧！
main_line_en: If we burn, you burn with us!
main_character: 凯特尼斯·伊夫狄恩 / Katniss Everdeen

main_line: 没有嫉妒，就没有爱情。
main_line_en: There is no love without jealousy.

film_title: 对一个不受怀疑的公民的调查
film_title_en: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
main_line: 最干净的人，往往最有资格把自己洗白。
main_line_en: The cleanest man is often the one most entitled to wash himself clean.

main_line: 舞会一旦下毒，天堂和地狱只隔一支舞。
main_line_en: Once the party is poisoned, heaven and hell are only a dance apart.
main_character: 舞团群像 / the dance troupe

main_line: 如果你走进另一栋房子——你可能再也回不来了。
main_line_en: If you walk into another house, you might never come back.

main_line: 如果你知道他们在做什么，你还会保持沉默吗？
main_line_en: If you knew what they were doing, would you still stay silent?

film_title_en: 西遊記大結局之仙履奇緣
main_line: 曾经有一份真诚的爱情放在我面前，我没有珍惜……
main_line_en: There was once a sincere love placed before me, and I did not cherish it…

main_line: 他们让我们都为这一天受训：「无畏、骄傲、孤独。不需要任何人，只要牺牲。一切为了祖国。」天哪，全是空话。
main_line_en: They made us all train for this day: 'To be fearless and proud and alone. To need no one, just sacrifice. All for the Fatherland.' Oh God, all just empty words.

main_line: 想吃肉，就得等。
main_line_en: If you want meat, you have to wait.
main_character: 肉铺房东 / The butcher landlord

main_line: 欢迎来参加派对，伙计。
main_line_en: Welcome to the party, pal.

main_line: 阿提卡！阿提卡！
main_line_en: Attica! Attica!
main_character: 桑尼·沃尔奇克 / Sonny Wortzik

main_line: 如果战争败了，德意志民族是否灭亡也就无关紧要了。
main_line_en: If the war is lost, it is of no concern to me if the people perish.
main_character: 阿道夫·希特勒 / Adolf Hitler

main_line: 流氓跟细菌是一样的。
main_line_en: Yakuza are just like germs.

main_line: 饮食男女，人之大欲存焉。
main_line_en: Food, drink, man, woman—basic human desires.

main_line: 敌人不在山上，在系统里面。
main_line_en: The enemy is not up on the hill — it is inside the system.

film_title_en: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
main_line: 蒙托克见。
main_line_en: Meet me in Montauk.

main_line: 你要出人头地。
main_line_en: You have to make something of yourself.

main_line: 初恋是小事——却足以把一辈子的天气改掉。
main_line_en: First love is a little thing—yet it can change the weather of a whole life.

main_line: 设身处地去理解你的敌人。
main_line_en: Empathize with your enemy.
main_character: 罗伯特·麦克纳马拉 / Robert S. McNamara

main_line: 死人只知道一件事：活着更好。
main_line_en: The dead know only one thing: it is better to be alive.

main_line: 废墟里的规矩只有一条：肉体换口粮，背叛就挨打。
main_line_en: In the ruins there is only one rule: flesh for rations — betrayal means a beating.
main_character: 妓女团体 / the prostitutes' gang

main_line: 我们今生所做的一切，都会在永恒中回响。
main_line_en: What we do in life echoes in eternity.

main_line: 每当我想起我的妻子，我总是先想到她的头。
main_line_en: When I think of my wife, I always think of her head.

main_line: 别开枪——我们是英国人！……啊不，是法国人！
main_line_en: Don't shoot—we're English! …Ah no, French!

main_line: 我累了，老板。我好想回家。
main_line_en: I'm tired, boss. … I want to go home.

main_line: 它会一直等——在你曾经归来的地方。
main_line_en: He will keep waiting—at the place where you used to come home.

main_line: 不如我们从头来过。
main_line_en: Let's start over.

main_line: 你善良。你聪明。你重要。
main_line_en: You is kind. You is smart. You is important.
main_character: 艾比利恩·克拉克 / Aibileen Clark

main_line: 公主，这可是我们的命啊。
main_line_en: Princess, this is a matter of life and death for us.

main_line: 忘掉圣山，去过你自己的生活。
main_line_en: Forget the holy mountain — go live your own life.

main_line: 只连接：把散文与激情、世俗与诗意连在一起。
main_line_en: Only connect! Only connect the prose and the passion.
main_character: 玛格丽特·施莱格尔 / Margaret Schlegel

main_line: 出来混，迟早要还的。
main_line_en: You play the game, sooner or later you pay.

main_line: 有时候，正是那些谁也不看好的人，做成了谁也无法想象的事。
main_line_en: Sometimes it is the people no one imagines anything of who do the things that no one can imagine.

main_line: 带她去月球看看。
main_line_en: Take her to the moon for me.

main_line: 时间摧毁一切。
main_line_en: Time destroys all things.

main_line: 你把我当成了人，可我其实是狼。
main_line_en: You thought I was human — but I am the wolf.

main_line: 那可不是一块写字板——这一笔，可擦不掉了，伙计。
main_line_en: That ain't no Etch A Sketch. This is one doodle that can't be undid, homeskillet.

main_line: 我想让它飞。
main_line_en: I want to let it fly.

main_line: 变脸的绝活，只传男不传女。
main_line_en: The secret of face-changing is passed only to males.
main_character: 变脸王 / The King of Masks

main_line: 被蹂躏的人若化作猫，复仇便不再讲人间道理。
main_line_en: When the violated return as cats, revenge no longer answers to human reason.
main_character: 母女亡灵 / the ghost mother and daughter

main_line: 敬那些做梦的人——哪怕看起来愚蠢。
main_line_en: Here's to the ones who dream, foolish as they may seem.

main_line: 没有人是无辜的。
main_line_en: No one is innocent.

main_line: 为了你，我愿意天天都是生日。
main_line_en: For you, every day can be a birthday.

main_line: 无论冬春，土地都会给出答案。
main_line_en: Winter or spring, the land always answers back.

main_line: 地球上每十二人就有一支枪。问题只剩：怎么把另外十一个人也武装起来？
main_line_en: There's one firearm for every twelve people on the planet. The only question is: How do we arm the other eleven?

main_line: 请问，有没有一位叫藤井树的同学？
main_line_en: Excuse me, is there a student named Fujii Tree in your class?

main_line: 我要我的儿子出人头地。
main_line_en: I want my son to become somebody.

main_line: 我得用科学，把这该死的局面搞定。
main_line_en: I'm going to have to science the shit out of this.

main_line: 信念若怕偶然，也就怕了整个夜晚。
main_line_en: If faith fears chance, it also fears the whole night.

main_line: 战俘营里说一声圣诞快乐，比投降更危险。
main_line_en: In a POW camp, saying Merry Christmas can be more dangerous than surrender.
main_character: 劳伦斯／米野／杰克 / Lawrence / Yonoi / Jack

main_line: 你永远无法真正理解一个人——除非你钻进他的皮肤里走上一圈。
main_line_en: You never really understand a person until you consider things from his point of view... until you climb into his skin and walk around in it.

main_line: 要不我们跳过跳舞，直接进入我杀你的环节？
main_line_en: How about we just skip the dancing and get right to the part where I kill you?

main_line: 人类注定要灭亡。
main_line_en: The human race is doomed.

main_line: 新世界的门一旦打开，就再也关不上了。
main_line_en: Once the door to the new world opens, it never closes again.

main_line: 如果你是鸟，那我也是鸟。
main_line_en: If you're a bird, I'm a bird.

main_line: 我想知道真相。
main_line_en: I want to know the truth.

main_line: 我女儿在电影里，我来看我女儿。
main_line_en: My daughter is in the film — I came to see my daughter.

main_line: 你永远逃不掉。
main_line_en: You can never get away from it.

main_line: 梦是会传染的。
main_line_en: Dreams are contagious.
main_character: 题旨 / 千叶敦子意境

main_line: 和平若只靠忘记危险来维持，那它随时会碎。
main_line_en: If peace is kept only by forgetting danger, it can shatter at any moment.
main_character: 后藤队长等 / Captain Goto et al.

film_title_en: The Bitter Tears of Petra von Kant
main_line: 爱会让人变得残忍。
main_line_en: Love can make people cruel.

main_line: 逃向南方的颜色太鲜艳，结局只能用火药收场。
main_line_en: The colors of fleeing south are too vivid — the ending can only be settled with gunpowder.
main_character: 费迪南／玛丽安娜 / Ferdinand / Marianne

film_title_en: Why Don't You Play in Hell?
main_line: 地狱里不好好拍电影，要在哪儿拍？
main_line_en: If you won't make a movie in hell, where will you?
main_character: 电影青年帮 / the amateur film crew

main_line: 诗不属于写它的人，而属于需要它的人。
main_line_en: Poetry doesn't belong to those who write it, but to those who need it.
main_character: 巴勃罗·聂鲁达 / Pablo Neruda

main_line: 我们每个人，偶尔都会有一点疯狂。
main_line_en: We all go a little mad sometimes.

main_line: 蛇。为什么偏偏是蛇？
main_line_en: Snakes. Why did it have to be snakes?

main_line: 听不见的人，有时比谁都听得清。
main_line_en: Those who cannot hear sometimes listen more clearly than anyone.

main_line: 灯一亮，女人的命就被拴在院子里。
main_line_en: When the lantern is lit, a woman's fate is tied to the courtyard.

main_line: 原爆的那天，天空比什么都亮。
main_line_en: On the day of the bomb, the sky was brighter than anything.

main_line: 我们女人总是独自一人。
main_line_en: We women are always alone.

main_line: 人们来绿洲，是为了能做的事；留下，是为了能成为的人。
main_line_en: People come to the OASIS for all the things they can do, but they stay for all the things they can be.

main_line: 也许，一个人的牺牲能够拯救这个世界。
main_line_en: Perhaps one man’s sacrifice can save the world.

main_line: 没有慈悲，人就不成其为人。
main_line_en: Without mercy, man is not a human being.
main_character: 母亲 / 太郎之母（遗训）

main_line: 校园里没有退路。
main_line_en: There is no way back on campus.
main_character: 校园暴力语境 / School-violence milieu

main_line: 我想知道我来自哪里。
main_line_en: I want to know where I come from.

main_line: 你身上有红的。
main_line_en: You've got red on you.
main_character: 电视主播／众人（反复） / TV anchors / recurring

main_line: 没有所谓好的死亡。
main_line_en: There is no such thing as a good death.

main_line: 我在雨中歌唱——多么荣耀的感觉！
main_line_en: I'm singing in the rain, just singing in the rain! What a glorious feeling, I'm happy again!

main_line: 我们不要别的世界。我们要的是镜子。
main_line_en: We don't need other worlds. We need mirrors.

main_line: 不。我要走自己的路。
main_line_en: Nah. Imma do my own thing.
main_character: 迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯 / Miles Morales

main_line: 愿原力与你同在。
main_line_en: May the Force be with you.

main_line: 不管你是谁——我一向仰赖陌生人的善意。
main_line_en: Whoever you are—I have always depended on the kindness of strangers.
main_character: 布兰奇·杜波依斯 / Blanche DuBois

main_line: 再大的网络，也大不过一家人同心。
main_line_en: No network is bigger than a family pulling together.

main_line: 对她说。把话告诉她。
main_line_en: Talk to her. Tell her that.

main_line: 你要学会做你自己；做到这一点，就什么都不用怕。
main_line_en: Learn to be yourself — once you can, you needn’t fear anything.

main_line: 你安于什么，就会得到什么。
main_line_en: You get what you settle for.

main_line: 兄弟可以一起闯祸，却很难一起长大。
main_line_en: Brothers can get into trouble together — growing up together is harder.

main_line: 占领可以改规矩，改不了人要有尊严地活。
main_line_en: Occupation can rewrite the rules — not a person's need to live with dignity.
main_character: 基达纳／萨提玛 / Kidane / Satima

main_line: 我走自己的路。
main_line_en: I walk my own path.

main_line: 人被逼急了，什么都做得出来。
main_line_en: When people are driven to the edge, they can do anything.
main_character: 大海等群像 / Dahai and others

main_line: 你以为你可以审判别人吗？
main_line_en: Do you think you can judge others?

main_line: 就算被吃掉，我也想和你在一起。
main_line_en: Even if I get eaten, I still want to be with you.

film_title_en: Valerie and Her Week of Wonders
main_line: 我不知道自己是谁。
main_line_en: I don’t know who I am.

main_line: 生活被一句话一句话说完之前，人已经不在场了。
main_line_en: Before life is finished being spoken sentence by sentence, the person has already left the room.

main_line: 把这好运符带着——等战争结束，再还给我。
main_line_en: Keep this good-luck charm—and give it back to me when the war is over.

main_line: 我想起了童年，也想起了我曾经是个孩子。
main_line_en: I remember my childhood, and that I was once a child.

main_line: 我妻子从不会说谎。
main_line_en: My wife never lies.

main_line: 记住，乔治——没有一个拥有朋友的人，会是失败者。
main_line_en: Remember, George: no man is a failure who has friends.

main_line: 活了！它活了！它活了！
main_line_en: Alive! It's alive! It's ALIVE!
main_character: 弗雷德里克·弗兰肯斯坦 / Dr. Frederick Frankenstein

main_line: 最难的不是老去，是学会对过去的旋律保持沉默。
main_line_en: The hardest part is not growing old — it is learning to stay silent before the melodies of the past.
